title: Security of Externalized Memory in LLM Agents: A Survey
abstract: Large language model agents increasingly rely on externalized memory systems including RAG stores and persistent memory. This paper surveys poisoning, injection and backdoor attacks against agent memory, proposes a defense taxonomy covering sanitization, provenance tracking and access control, and identifies evaluation gaps.

title: Interpretability of Graph Neural Networks: Methods and Challenges
abstract: Graph neural networks are deployed in safety-critical domains. We survey explainability methods including gradient attribution, mask learning and subgraph search, covering 180 papers from 2019-2024, and identify key evaluation gaps in real-world benchmarks.
